hints.content: A relative minimum point is a point that is lower than all other graph points around it. It's like the lowest point on a "valley."

The graph has three relative minimum points in the given section. One at $(-7,-7)$, one at $(0,-3)$, and one at $(4,-3)$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A function is made up of line segments and curved lines. A line segment connects negative eight, negative five to negative seven, negative seven. A line segment connects negative seven, negative seven to four, three. A line segment connects four, three to negative one, two. From one, two the function decreases at a non linear rate to zero, negative three. Then it increases at a non linear rate to two, seven. Then it decreases at a non linear rate to four, negative three. Then it increases at a non linear rate to five, two. A line segment connects five, two to eight, four.
